body.condition: With \(\mathcal X=\sigma((X_{uv})_{1\le u\le S,\ 1\le v\le T})\), every cohort \(s\), unit \(i\), and deterministic \(v=(v_1,\ldots,v_T)\in\mathbb R^T\) satisfy \[\operatorname{Var}\!\left(\sum_{t=1}^{T}v_t\{Q_{sti}-m_s(X_{st})\}\mathrel{\Big|}z_0,\mathcal X\right)\le B^2\left(1+\frac{8\beta_0}{1-\rho_0}\right)\sum_{t=1}^{T}v_t^2.\]
